summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K to register 4,761,905 shares of common stock issued as consideration for license fees and professional services from Palantir Technologies under an existing software license agreement. No cash price per share, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing includes a legal opinion from Gibson Dunn & Crutcher LLP. This is a routine equity issuance for services, not a special situation; it lacks any acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or strategic catalyst.
